newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar off, July breaks support.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar off, July breaks support.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures continued to rack up losses ahead of the May contract's expiry on Wednesday, dealers said, as July slipped under nearby support.
At 1130 EDT, the most-active contract stood at 11.00 cents per lb, down 0.07 cent, having traded from 11.05 to 10.97 cents. May fell 0.15 to 11.34, while the outer months eased 0.06 to 0.03.
The May/July spread tightened to 0.34 cent from 0.42 cent at Monday's close.
Volume was estimated at 13,019 lots as of 1100 EDT.
Fund selling pushed July under support at 11.00 cents but failed to pressure the contract below its next downside target of 10.91 cents, the recent low hit on Friday.
Market sources widely expect sell stops to be resting around 10.90 cents. If triggered, the contract could fall to 10.77 cents, the low made on April 17, dealers said.
In the near-term, trade scale-down buying could hold July close to key 11.00 cents, they said.
Resistance was seen at 11.18-11.20 cents in July, where producer selling is expected to emerge.
Open interest in May fell 3,551 lots to 21,223 lots, as of early Monday. July gained 1,066 lots to stand at 86,835 lots.
((-- S Rostler, New York Commodities Desk, 212 859 1640))
